Greenville Discord. https://discord.com/channels/475538426863550465/475539939342286848/936491711453069413 ==Overview== It's big, it's practical, it's a Sumo. Introducing our newest Rockies if you want a big, practical and capable family car to haul or even just go up the mountains. For our newest Rockies, we have added some exterior changes for a tougher, bigger look. We have also included some trims to suit different types of people. Whether they have a family or not, we have trims for everyone. Our cheapest base model is still as classic as our other models. It features our standard Symmetrical AWD. At $26,000 you're getting a decent deal for a big off-road family car. But for those who wants more comfort on road, you can get our Limited, Touring or Premium trim for leather trimmed upholstery and an upgraded audio system and a power sunroof. For more power on road, get our Onyx XT trim on these. It features an upgraded 260 horsepower flat-4 with a turbocharger. It's not a lot, but it's still enough for your family to haul your things. But if you have a bit more cash, you can get our top of the line Wilderness trim. Our Wilderness trim includes a new front bumper with an increased ground height. We also put plastic trims around the fenders and trim to protect your paint from any sticks that might scratch your paint. You may love it or hate it for its price, but this car may be for everybody since we have engineered this car to be as safe as possible. When crash tested, our ratings show a perfect score on every category indicating this car is very safe to drive while still maintaining practicality and comfort on road or on the mountains. The Rockies.
